title: Sauna-and-lake cabins for remote workers
one_liner: Week-long cabin rentals with sauna, fibre and a desk on Lake Orivesi for remote workers.
customer: Remote-working professionals in Helsinki and abroad who want a quiet working retreat.
problem: Holiday cottages rarely have reliable internet, a proper desk or availability outside summer.
solution: Two renovated lakeside cabins with fibre, ergonomic desks, wood-fired sauna and weekly rates.
revenue_model: Weekly rental fee; optional add-ons (meals, guided nature trips).

clarifications.question: Do you already own the cabins?
clarifications.answer: One cabin is owned; the second would be rented.
